name: w60_bc_a
_comment: Beam cap A (kits/w60_beamcap.mjs, pilot pilots/w60_bc_a.json): a Shuttle at rest by Kit Sub Port; F12 on; `w` selects wëap 337 BC Probe; Space held 18 s fires wëap 336 BC Spray (a green spoke at a random angle every 0.2 s, about 36 s each); 4 s later Ctrl held 68 s (the red probe straight ahead, Reload 20 s) while the spokes fill the table and expire; then a 0.5 s Left turn. Count the spokes and read when the red probe appears.
